signature_matches.name: create process on Linux
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: create process on Linux
    namespace: host-interaction/process/create
    authors:
      - joakim@intezer.com
      - mehunhoff@google.com
    scopes:
      static: basic block
      dynamic: call
    mbc:
      - Process::Create Process [C0017]
    examples:
      - 7351f8a40c5450557b24622417fc478d:0x40236D
  features:
    - and:
      - or:
        - os: linux
        - os: android
      - or:
        - api: execve
        - and:
          - match: execute syscall
          - arch: aarch64
          - number: 0xdd = execve
        - api: execl
        - api: execlp
        - api: execle
        - api: execv
        - api: execvp
        - api: execvpe
        - api: posix_spawn
        - api: posix_spawnp
        - api: popen
        - api: fork

signature_matches.name: set socket configuration
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: set socket configuration
    namespace: communication/socket
    authors:
      - michael.hunhoff@mandiant.com
    scopes:
      static: function
      dynamic: call
    mbc:
      - Communication::Socket Communication::Set Socket Config [C0001.001]
    examples:
      - 6A352C3E55E8AE5ED39DC1BE7FB964B1:0x1000C1F0
  features:
    - or:
      - api: ws2_32.setsockopt
      - api: ws2_32.#21 = setsockopt
      - api: ws2_32.ioctlsocket
      - api: ws2_32.#10 = ioctlsocket
